caseName: New Jersey Department of Corrections v. Nash
caseNameFull: New Jersey Department of Corrections v. Nash and Carchman, Mercer County Prosecutor v. Nash

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certiorari in No. 84-835 is granted. Certiorari in No. 84-776 is granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition. Cases are consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 739 F. 2d 878.
